<title>Multivariate genome-wide analysis of sarcopenia reveals genetic comorbidity with urological diseases.</title>
<abstract>INTRODUCTION Sarcopenia is a prevalent age-related disorder characterized by progressive loss of muscle mass, strength, and physical performance. While genome-wide association studies (GWAS) have explored isolated traits, the multifactorial genetic architecture underlying sarcopenia remains poorly defined. Bidirectional Mendelian randomization (MR) was employed to assess causal relationships between sarcopenia and 30 urological diseases. RESULTS Multivariate GWAS identified 215 loci and 30,869 single-nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs) associated with polygenic architecture of sarcopenia.
